questions.content:
Coordination compound have great importance in biological systems. In this context which of
the following statements is incorrect?

options.content: Chlorophylls are green pigments in plants and contains calcium
Carboxypeptidase – A is an enzyme and contains zinc
Cyanocobalamin is B<sub>12</sub> and contains cobalt
Haemoglobin is the red pigment of blood and contains iron
